remarks:
May we present 37 Liberty St. in Fredonia! One of the Village's finer homes that has a masterful blend of original character and modern amenities!! Let's start our tour with the lovely landscaped grounds, a relaxing covered front porch and maintenance free composite rear deck that overlooks your sparkling inground pool! The pool has a concrete patio surrounding it and is fenced...behind the pool is plenty of yard that goes all the way back to the next street! Handy storage shed and appealing plantings round out this lovely lot. Inside features an amazing kitchen designed by 'The Gallery' and it's focus is the huge white eating island, counter to ceiling white subway tile and striking black cabinetry, new lighting, stainless steel appliances plus hardwood flooring and a sliding door that takes you right out to deck and pool! Stunning! The bright and airy clean and crisp living room flows through french doors into a 1st floor bedroom, office or exercise room-your choice!! Also on the 1st floor is a beautiful bathroom with hardwood floors, a cozy family room with fireplace, appealing mudroom off the deck that is so handy and first floor laundry nook! The 2nd floor features 3 more bedrooms, one bedroom with balcony overlooking pool (a newer addition), a newer full bathroom and plenty of closets including walk-in! Impeccable taste throughout!!! Quality design and materials reflect taste and perfect planning. In 2000 a large 2-story addition was built making the back of the home only 26 years old! Custom blinds, recessed lighting, updated electrical, updated plumbing with copper and PVC, newer furnace, newer roof, vinyl siding, porch, patio, deck, landscaping, concrete driveway. The 16' x 32' inground pool has a 2 year old heater and replaced liner and pump. And how about this garage that doubles as a pool house!!! Car storage plus a door that opens directly out to the pool...it has a small kitchen/party room area and a half bathroom as well! Great for pool gatherings!!!
Not too far from University and a 10 minute walk to Village Parks and shops. Fantastic layout, great locale and high quality design...turn-key and move in!!! *See attached video!
